plain: Lyn Buchanan, a former US Army sergeant, talks about the idea that UFOs tend to appear near nuclear sites such as Chernobyl, the Soviet nuclear plant. He says he has written a paper on it, and that if his idea is right, their appearances there have nothing to do with the usual explanation, but rather with disturbances in space and time.
